text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: This is a non-review research article that uses future land use and land cover change (LULCC) projections—specifically from the LUH2 dataset under SSP245 and SSP370 scenarios—as inputs to model carbon and water dynamics across the conterminous United States. While the study includes national-scale spatial implementation, compares two future socioeconomic scenarios, and presents mapped results related to LULCC effects, its primary objective is not to predict or simulate LULC change itself. Instead, LULC projections are adopted from external sources (Hurtt et al., 2020) and used as forcing data to assess impacts on the terrestrial carbon sink. The paper does not develop or validate LULC predictions, nor does it report quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC modeling. Thus, LULC prediction is an input/step rather than the central focus.)
